# html2canvas

Pinned upstream version: 1.4.1 (MIT), by Niklas von Hertzen.

- Source/release: https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas/tree/v1.4.1
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/dist/html2canvas.min.js
- License: `html2canvas-LICENSE.txt` (included verbatim).

The browser loads this local asset; driver printing does not fetch a runtime CDN.
The library renders the native ERPNext Print Format in a sandboxed same-origin frame.
It is a DOM/CSS renderer, not a PDF engine or physical-printer acknowledgement.
Complex CSS and cross-origin assets require native ERPNext print or an adapted format.
